properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued July 30 at 11:11AM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
At 1111 AM EDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm over
Holly Hill, moving southeast at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Daytona Beach, Port Orange, Ormond Beach, New Smyrna Beach, and South
Daytona.
properties.instruction: If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued July 30 at 11:02AM EDT until July 30 at 12:00PM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
SMWMLB

The National Weather Service in Melbourne has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Flagler Beach to Volusia-Brevard County Line 0-20 nm...

* Until noon EDT.

* At 1102 AM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located near Port Orange,
moving southeast at 25 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots, suddenly higher
waves, lightning and heavy downpours. Make sure all on
board are wearing life jackets. Return to safe harbor if
possible.

* Locations impacted include...
New Smyrna Beach, New Smyrna Beach Airport, Bethune Beach, Turtle
Mound, and Port Orange.
properties.area: Flagler Beach to Volusia-Brevard County Line 0-20 nm

properties.title: Flash Flood Warning issued July 30 at 10:56AM EDT until July 30 at 11:45AM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
properties.description:
At 1056 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain across the warned
area. Between 2 and 3 inches of rain have fallen. The expected
rainfall rate may reach 1 inch in 1 hour. Flash flooding is ongoing
or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by heavy rain.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
South Kingstown, Westerly, Narragansett, Hopkinton, Charlestown,
Richmond and Exeter.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

properties.title: Flood Advisory issued July 30 at 10:45AM EDT until July 30 at 12:45PM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...A portion of west central Florida, including the following
counties, Hernando and Pasco.

* WHEN...Until 1245 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 2 and 3 inches of rain
have fallen.

over the area. This additional rain will result in minor
flooding.

- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

properties.title: Flash Flood Warning issued July 30 at 7:39AM MST until July 30 at 9:45AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Paria River in...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 945 AM MST /1045 AM MDT/.

* At 739 AM MST /839 AM MDT/, automated river gauges on the Paria
River near Lees Ferry indicated that the flood wave has arrived.
More than a 4 foot rise was detected around 530 AM MST. Levels are
slowly falling. Flash flooding is ongoing.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding in and around the Paria
River.

SOURCE...Gauge indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Paria River.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Lees Ferry.

This includes the Colorado River near mile marker 0.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Lees Ferry Camp Site.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Paria River and Colorado River.
properties.instruction:
Get away from the Paria River slot canyon! Flood waters are flowing
down the Paria River.

properties.title: Marine Weather Statement issued July 30 at 10:26AM EDT by NWS Jacksonville FL
properties.description:
A Marine Weather Statement has been issued for the following areas...
Coastal waters from St. Augustine to Flagler Beach FL out 20 NM...

At 1025 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated an area of thunderstorms,
capable of producing winds to around 30 knots. This thunderstorm was
located near Palm Coast, moving east at 20 knots.
properties.instruction:
Mariners can expect gusty winds to around 30 knots, locally higher
waves, and lightning strikes. Boaters should seek safe harbor
immediately until this storm passes.
properties.area: Coastal waters from St. Augustine to Flagler Beach FL out 20 NM

properties.title: Flood Warning issued July 30 at 9:13AM CDT by NWS Corpus Christi TX
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Texas...

Nueces River Near Three Rivers affecting Live Oak County.

Nueces River Near Tilden affecting McMullen County.

For the Nueces River...including Cotulla, Tilden, Three Rivers,
Mathis, Bluntzer, Calallen...Major flooding is forecast.

- Forecast...The river is expected to fall to 17.5 feet Tuesday
morning.
- Flood stage is 14.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Even 6 inches of fast-moving flood water can knock you off your feet
and a depth of 2 feet will float your car. Never try to walk, swim,
or drive through such swift water. If you come upon flood waters,
stop, turn around and go another way.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/crp.

properties.title: Air Quality Alert issued July 27 at 10:40AM MDT by NWS Missoula MT
properties.description:
AQAMSO

* WHAT...Air Quality Advisory due to smoke from wildfires.

Air Quality Index ranging from Moderate to Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups.

* WHERE...All Areas on the Nez Perce Reservation.

* WHEN...Until 10:00 AM PDT Friday July 31.

* IMPACTS...Those who experience health effects from smoke include
children under 18, elders, pregnant women, people with asthma
or have difficulty breathing, diabetes, heart problems or
otherwise compromised health, and people who have high exposure
(those who work, exercise, or spend extensive time outdoors).
properties.instruction:
Under the most severe pollution level, sensitive groups should avoid
outdoor exposure and limit indoor activities, and everyone should
restrict their outdoor activities.

Idaho Department of Health and Welfare
https://healthandwelfare.idaho.gov/health-wellness/environmental-
health/wildfire-smoke
Idaho Smoke Information Hotline: 1-800-345-1007
